chunks: And we [Jinn] touched/reached the heaven, so we found it full of fierce guards and shooting flames.

key_terms.السَّمَاءَ: The heaven/sky, referring to the celestial realms
key_terms.شُهُباً: Shooting stars or flames used as projectiles

ai.seo_question: What did the Jinn find when they tried to reach the heavens?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from the Jinn's pre-Islamic ability to eavesdrop on the lower heavens to the intensified guarding following the Prophet's ascension (Mi'raj) and the advent of the Imams. The 'shooting flames' (shuhub) are interpreted not merely as physical meteors but as divine signs of authority, ensuring that the celestial secrets remain exclusive to the chosen messengers and their successors.
